name: Radiative Gaussian Point Cloud Model
definition: A Gaussian point cloud model designed for X-ray imaging that replaces the view-dependent Spherical Harmonics (SH) of RGB 3DGS with a view-independent Radiation Intensity Response Function (RIRF), exploiting the isotropic nature of X-ray attenuation.
summary: The Radiative Gaussian Point Cloud Model is an X-ray scene representation that replaces view-dependent spherical harmonics with a view-independent Radiation Intensity Response Function to model isotropic attenuation.
